question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Whistleblower Protection Act (H R 4646)
plain_language: This bill extends whistleblower protections to employees of Housing and Urban Development contractors and grantees, including on contracts signed before 2013. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Concur in Senate Adt to House Adt to Senate Adt — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
plain_language: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote, under suspension of the rules, was on accepting the Senate's latest changes to the bill after the chambers traded versions, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea accepts the Senate's version; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Agree — Providing for the concurrence by the House in the Senate amendment to H.R. 6644, with amendment (H RES 1299)
bill_title: Providing for the concurrence by the House in the Senate amendment to H.R. 6644, with amendment.
plain_language: The official title of H.Res. 1299 is “Providing for the concurrence by the House in the Senate amendment to H.R. 6644, with amendment.” No official summary was available. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports agreeing to it; a Nay opposes it.
